description: This file defines the CartRepository class responsible for managing shopping cart data within an Android application. It handles persisting cart items using SharedPreferences and JSON serialization, providing methods for loading, adding, updating, removing items, totaling, and clearing the cart.

classes.name: CartRepository
classes.description: Manages cart items persistence and manipulation in an Android app using SharedPreferences.

methods.name: loadCart
methods.description: Loads the cart data from SharedPreferences, deserializes JSON into CartItem objects.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Serializes the current cart state into JSON and saves it to SharedPreferences.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart, increasing quantity if it already exists.

methods.name: increase
methods.description: Increases the quantity of a cart item by product ID.

methods.name: decrease
methods.description: Decreases the quantity of a cart item by product ID, removing it if quantity reaches zero.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart by product ID.

methods.name: total
methods.description: Calculates the total price of items in the cart.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.
